title.target: xià yìzhī xiāngzǐ wǎng nǎ qù

pairs.target: hé lù suǒ de qiángshàng guà zhe yìzhī kōng mùxiāng , xiāngdǐ kāi le sìtiáo zhǎi fèng .
pairs.english: An empty wooden crate hung on the Joint Routes Office wall, with four narrow slots cut into its base.
pairs.hanzi: 合路所的墙上挂着一只空木箱，箱底开了四条窄缝。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jìnmén shí , yígè chuān duǎnguà de nánrén zhèng shēnshǒu tuō zhe xiāngdǐ , ruǎn héng zài lìngyìbiān yáodòng xiǎo jiǎo lún , shéngzi yì jǐn , mùxiāng xié zhe shēngqǐ , lǐmiàn de shízǐ huālā huá dào yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: When Tavi entered, a man in a short jacket was holding up the crate's base while Ruan Heng turned a small winch on the other side. The rope tightened; the crate rose at an angle and the stones inside slid noisily into one corner.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维进门时，一个穿短褂的男人正伸手托着箱底，阮衡在另一边摇动小绞轮，绳子一紧，木箱斜着升起，里面的石子哗啦滑到一角。

pairs.target: " wǒ shànggèyuè jiù shuō zhè xiāngzǐ bùnéng quán suàn píngdǐ huò . " nánrén shuō .
pairs.english: “I said last month that this crate can't simply be counted as flat-bottomed cargo,” the man said.
pairs.hanzi: “我上个月就说这箱子不能全算平底货。”男人说。

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ nǐ bié ná tā dǐngzhù lúnzǐ . " ruǎn héng tíngxià shǒu , " nǐ yì tuō , xié duōshǎo dōu biàn le . "
pairs.english: “So don't brace the wheel with it.” Ruan Heng stopped working. “When you hold it up, you change the tilt.”
pairs.hanzi: “所以你别拿它顶住轮子。”阮衡停下手，“你一托，斜多少都变了。”

pairs.target: nánrén sōngshǒu , xiāng jiǎo huàng le yíxià . tǎ wéi zhàn zài ménpáng , xiǎnxiē yě shēnshǒu qù fú , kàndào xiàmiàn wéizhe de xiàn cái tíngzhù .
pairs.english: The man let go and a crate corner swayed. Standing by the door, Tavi almost reached to steady it too, then stopped when he saw the cordon below.
pairs.hanzi: 男人松手，箱角晃了一下。塔维站在门旁，险些也伸手去扶，看到下面围着的线才停住。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng ràng tā rào dào jiǎo lún zhèbiān , kàn xiāngdǐ nà sìtiáo fèng : fèng yuán shì gěi jiùhuò jià de kǎ chǐ liú de , hòulái huàn le jiēhuò tái , xiāngzǐ hái zài zhàojiù zhuāngyùn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had him come around to the winch to look at the four slots beneath the crate: they were originally made for the old cargo rack's locking teeth. The receiving platform had since changed, but the crates were still shipped as before.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡让他绕到绞轮这边，看箱底那四条缝：缝原是给旧货架的卡齿留的，后来换了接货台，箱子还在照旧装运。

pairs.target: zhè zhǐshì cóng fēng zhàn sònglái de kōng yàng xiāng , shízǐ xiàn zhuāngzuò pèizhòng . zhēnzhèng de jiēhuò tái zài nánbiān liǎngrì lù wài , fēng dà de shíhòu , zuìhòu yíduàn diào yùn cháng yào tíng .
pairs.english: This was only an empty sample crate sent from Wind Trestle; the stones had just been added as ballast. The actual receiving platform was two days' journey south, where the final hoist often had to stop in strong winds.
pairs.hanzi: 这只是从风栈送来的空样箱，石子现装作配重。真正的接货台在南边两日路外，风大的时候，最后一段吊运常要停。

pairs.target: lái qǔ bàogào de nánrén shì chéngnèi huò xíng de guǎnshì , yùnfèi àn néng guò de xiāng shù jié , bùnéng měi yùdào fēng jiù tīng yíjù wǎnghòu pái .
pairs.english: The man collecting the report managed a city freight firm; carriage fees were settled by the number of crates that got through, and he could not accept being told to wait every time there was wind.
pairs.hanzi: 来取报告的男人是城内货行的管事，运费按能过的箱数结，不能每遇到风就听一句往后排。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng wèn tā yuànbuyuànyì bǎ tíng guò de xiāng hào yě liúxià . guǎnshì shuō kěyǐ , yòu pà zìjǐ de xiāngzǐ dānliè chūlái , pángrén biàn dōu shuō shì tā zhuānghuò yǒu cuò .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng asked if he would also leave the numbers of crates that had been stopped. The manager agreed but feared that listing his crates alone would make everyone else blame his loading.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡问他愿不愿意把停过的箱号也留下。管事说可以，又怕自己的箱子单列出来，旁人便都说是他装货有错。

pairs.target: liǎng rén zài zhuōbiān zhēng le yíhuìer , zuìhòu lìngjiā yìlán , jì tíngyùn shí biéjiā de xiāngzǐ guò méi guò , bùnéng zhī chāo tā de .
pairs.english: They argued by the table for a while, finally adding a separate column to record whether other firms' crates had passed during the stoppage; they could not copy only his.
pairs.hanzi: 两人在桌边争了一会儿，最后另加一栏，记停运时别家的箱子过没过，不能只抄他的。

alignment.english: whether other firms' crates had passed

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng guǎnshì zǒu hòu cái wèn , zhècì shìbushì yào tì nà jiā huò xíng gǎi xiāngdǐ .
pairs.english: Only after the manager left did Tavi ask whether they were to alter crate bases for that freight firm this time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等管事走后才问，这次是不是要替那家货行改箱底。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng bǎ wěituō pūkāi , zhǐ gěi tā kàn , gù tāmen de shì jǐduàn lù gòngyòng de zhuǎnyùn huì , búshì yìjiā .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng spread out the commission and showed him that their employer was the transfer association shared by several road sections, rather than a single firm.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡把委托铺开，指给他看，雇他们的是几段路共用的转运会，不是一家。

pairs.target: huò xíng xiǎng duō guò huò , jiēhuò de rén xiǎng shǎo chāi xiāng , shānxià de duǎntú jiǎofū què kào chāizhuāng zhèng gōngqián . xiān kàn shíjì zěnme jiāojiē , cáinéng shuō nǎlǐ néng gǎi .
pairs.english: The freight firms wanted more cargo through; receivers wanted less unpacking, while short-haul porters below earned their wages by unpacking and repacking. They must first see how handovers actually worked before saying what could change.
pairs.hanzi: 货行想多过货，接货的人想少拆箱，山下的短途脚夫却靠拆装挣工钱。先看实际怎么交接，才能说哪里能改。

pairs.target: " nà zǒng yǒurén bù gāoxìng . " " ǹg , wǒ yě xiǎng guò tiāo quánhuì gāoxìng de huó . " ruǎn héng bǎ yàng xiāng jiànghuí dìshàng , " méi zhǎodào . "
pairs.english: “Then someone will always be unhappy.” “Mm. I've thought about picking work that pleases everyone too.” Ruan Heng lowered the sample crate back to the floor. “Never found any.”
pairs.hanzi:
“那总有人不高兴。”
“嗯，我也想过挑全会高兴的活。”阮衡把样箱降回地上，“没找到。”

pairs.target: tāmen hòu rì shàngwǔ cóng tóng jiē nánmén dāgōngchē , zhù yíyè , cìrì dào fēng zhàn . shísù hé lùfèi réng zhào shíxí yuēdìng , shíliù zhōu méiyǒu dàoqī .
pairs.english: They would take a public cart from Copperstep's south gate the morning after next, stay one night and reach Wind Trestle the following day. Meals, lodging and fares remained under the placement agreement; the sixteen weeks were not over.
pairs.hanzi: 他们后日上午从铜阶南门搭公车，住一夜，次日到风栈。食宿和路费仍照实习约定，十六周没有到期。

pairs.target: yù hé hé níng qí dōu liúzài zhé tóng , nàlǐ wèi wán de shì zhàojiù yǒurén jiēzhe zuò , bù suí tāmen huàn yìzhāng zhuōzi jiùsuàn liǎojié .
pairs.english: Yuhe and Ningqi both remained in Zhetong; people were still carrying on the unfinished work there. It did not end just because they changed desks.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾和宁岐都留在折桐，那里未完的事照旧有人接着做，不随他们换一张桌子就算了结。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de huó xiānshì rèn xiāng hào , liáng jiēhuò chù de chǐcùn , gēnzhe kàn zhěngduàn jìnchū huò .
pairs.english: Tavi's work would begin with identifying crate numbers, measuring the receiving area and following the whole cargo handling sequence.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的活先是认箱号、量接货处的尺寸，跟着看整段进出货。

pairs.target: néng zuò de jiājù zhǔnbèi hé dúshù réng yóu ruǎn héng zhǐmíng , jiù táishàng de tiě jiàn bùxǔ zìjǐ qù shì , bǎi lǎoshī nà xiàng liànxí gèng bùnéng nálái gǎngōng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng would still specify what fixture preparation and readings he could do. He must not try the old platform's iron pieces on his own, much less use Instructor Bai's exercise to speed up work.
pairs.hanzi: 能做的夹具准备和读数仍由阮衡指明，旧台上的铁件不许自己去试，柏老师那项练习更不能拿来赶工。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yào dài de zhéchǐ fàngzài wěituō pángbiān , wèn yǒukōngshí néng bunéng zǒuzǒu fùjìn de gōnglù .
pairs.english: He put the folding ruler he would take beside the commission and asked if he could walk the nearby public roads in his free time.
pairs.hanzi: 他把要带的折尺放在委托旁边，问有空时能不能走走附近的公路。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng táiqǐ yǎn . tǎ wéi biàn bǎ zuórì de chàlù jiǎng le , méi lüè diào guǒyuán zhǎimén , shuō zìjǐ xiǎng xuéhuì kàn wán dìtú zhīhòu , zhēn néng bǎ yíduànlù zǒu míngbái .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng looked up. Tavi told him about yesterday's fork, without leaving out the narrow orchard gate, and said he wanted to learn to truly find his way along a route after reading its map.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡抬起眼。塔维便把昨日的岔路讲了，没略掉果园窄门，说自己想学会看完地图之后，真能把一段路走明白。

pairs.target: " dào le xiān wènqīng nǎtiáo hái tōng . " ruǎn héng shuō , " kòngxián shíhòu kěyǐ zǒu . guòyè de lù lìng shāngliáng , bié ràngwǒná zhe fànwǎn zhǎo nǐ . "
pairs.english: “First ask which roads are still open when we arrive,” Ruan Heng said. “You can walk in your free time. Overnight routes need another discussion. Don't make me look for you with my rice bowl in hand.”
pairs.hanzi: “到了先问清哪条还通。”阮衡说，“空闲时候可以走。过夜的路另商量，别让我拿着饭碗找你。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòu náchū kòu shīfu shuō de lián xiū hào , wèn chá jiù zhuǎnyùn bó gāi dìgěi shuí .
pairs.english: Tavi also brought out Master Kou's joint-repair number suggestion and asked whom to send an inquiry about the old transfer registers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维又拿出寇师傅说的联修号，问查旧转运簿该递给谁。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng gěi le tā xuégōng jiù kù de shōujiàn chù , jiào tā fùshàng tú míng yǔ chūchù ; wèibì zhǎo dédào , dàn xiān búbì jì yìzhěng bāo cāixiǎng . tāmen yìqǐ xiě hǎo cháxún tiáo , jiāojìn le ménkǒu de jiù kù zhuǎnsòng xiá .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng gave him the academy's old archive receiving address and told him to attach the drawing's title and source. They might not find it, but he need not send a whole bundle of guesses first. Together they wrote the inquiry and put it in the archive forwarding box by the door.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡给了他学宫旧库的收件处，叫他附上图名与出处；未必找得到，但先不必寄一整包猜想。他们一起写好查询条，交进了门口的旧库转送匣。

pairs.target: wǔhòu huídào xuégōng , tā bǎ xīn shōuxìn chù chāo gěi mǐlā hé yīwén . mǐlā zhī lái qǔ liǎngkē bèiyòng dīng , sū yǐ zài zuōfang děng tā , bùkěn zuòxià chī bǐng .
pairs.english: Back at the academy that afternoon, he copied the new postal address for Mira and Iven. Mira had only come for two spare nails; Suyi was waiting at the workshop, and she refused to sit and eat flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 午后回到学宫，他把新收信处抄给米拉和伊文。米拉只来取两颗备用钉，苏苡在作坊等她，不肯坐下吃饼。

pairs.target: yīwén tì tā bǎ dīng bāo jìnzhǐ lǐ , zhuīwèn tā nà kuài dǎng shuǐ piàn dàodǐ néng dǎng shuí de xié .
pairs.english: Iven wrapped the nails in paper for her and pressed her on whose shoes that splashguard could actually protect.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文替她把钉包进纸里，追问她那块挡水片到底能挡谁的鞋。

pairs.target: " xiān dǎng wǒ de . " tā shuō , " děng bù pō wǒ le , zài kǎolǜ nǐ de . "
pairs.english: “Mine first,” she said. “Once it stops splashing me, I'll consider yours.”
pairs.hanzi: “先挡我的。”她说，“等不泼我了，再考虑你的。”

pairs.target: tā zǒu hòu , yīwén yě yào qù jiàn shī nán . tǎ wéi sòngdào lóutīkǒu , wèn tā fùqīn yǒu huà le méiyǒu . tā shuō hái méiyǒu , shēngyīn qīng le xiē , yòu táitóu shuō zìjǐ jīnwǎn bù děng nà dùnfàn , huílái yào chī rè de , jiào tǎ wéi liú gè zuò .
pairs.english: After she left, Iven also had to see Shinan. Tavi walked him to the stairs and asked whether his father had said anything. Not yet, he said, his voice quieter; then he looked up and said he would not wait on that dinner tonight, but come back for a hot meal, and asked Tavi to save a seat.
pairs.hanzi: 她走后，伊文也要去见施南。塔维送到楼梯口，问他父亲有话了没有。他说还没有，声音轻了些，又抬头说自己今晚不等那顿饭，回来要吃热的，叫塔维留个座。

pairs.target: wǎnshàng tāmen guǒzhēn zài shítáng zuòxià , mǐlā tóufa shàng hái guà zhe yìdiǎn shī mùxiè . shuí yě méi tí gàobié , zhī zài tāngwǎn páng nuóchū yìxiǎokuài dìfāng , bǎ gèzì jiēxiàlái de zhùzhǐ chóngxīn xiě qīng .
pairs.english: That evening they did sit down in the dining hall; Mira still had some wet wood shavings in her hair. No one mentioned farewells. They simply cleared a little space beside the soup bowls and rewrote their respective upcoming addresses clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 晚上他们果真在食堂坐下，米拉头发上还挂着一点湿木屑。谁也没提告别，只在汤碗旁挪出一小块地方，把各自接下来的住址重新写清。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de nà xíng shēn dào le zhǐbiān , yīwén xiào tā , xīn dìfāng hái méi dào , xiān bǎ tāmen de dìpán zhàn le .
pairs.english: Tavi's line reached the edge of the paper. Iven teased him: he hadn't reached the new place yet and was already taking over their territory.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的那行伸到了纸边，伊文笑他，新地方还没到，先把他们的地盘占了。
